text_en: These are their family heads, and this is the genealogy of those who went up with me from Babylonia, in the reign of King Artaxerxes:
text_cn: 在阿塔薛西斯在位期间，与我从巴比伦一同起程的族长，和他们的祖谱，记载如下：

text_en: Of the descendants of Phinehas, Gershom. Of Ithamar, Daniel. Of David, Hattush,
text_cn: 丕乃哈斯的子孙，有革尔雄；依塔玛尔的子孙，有达尼耳；达味的子孙，有舍加尼雅的儿子哈突士；

text_en: of the descendants of Shecaniah. Of Parosh, Zechariah, with whom were registered one hundred fifty males.
text_cn: 帕洛士的子孙，有则加黎雅，同他登记的，有男子一百五十名；

text_en: Of the descendants of Pahath-moab, Eliehoenai son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.
text_cn: 帕哈特摩阿布的子孙，有则辣希雅的儿子厄里约乃，同他一起的，有男子二百名；

text_en: Of the descendants of Zattu, Shecaniah son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.
text_cn: 匝突的子孙，有雅哈齐耳的儿子舍加尼雅，同他一起的，有男子三百名；

text_en: Of the descendants of Adin, Ebed son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.
text_cn: 阿丁的子孙，有约纳堂的儿子厄贝得，同他一起的，有男子五十名；

text_en: Of the descendants of Elam, Jeshaiah son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.
text_cn: 厄蓝的子孙，有阿塔里雅的儿子耶沙雅，同他一起的，有男子七十名；

text_en: Of the descendants of Shephatiah, Zebadiah son of Michael, and with him eighty males.
text_cn: 舍法提雅的子孙，有米加耳的儿子则巴狄雅，同他一起的，有男子八十名；

text_en: Of the descendants of Joab, Obadiah son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred eighteen males.
text_cn: 约阿布的子孙，有耶希耳的儿子敖巴狄雅，同他一起的，有男子二百一十八名；

text_en: Of the descendants of Bani, Shelomith son of Josiphiah, and with him one hundred sixty males.
text_cn: 巴尼的子孙，有约息非雅的儿子舍罗米特，同他一起的，有男子一百六十名；

text_en: Of the descendants of Bebai, Zechariah son of Bebai, and with him twenty-eight males.
text_cn: 贝拜的子孙，有贝拜的儿子则加黎雅，同他一起的，有男子二十八名；

text_en: Of the descendants of Azgad, Johanan son of Hakkatan, and with him one hundred ten males.
text_cn: 阿次加得的子孙，有哈卡堂的儿子约哈南，同他一起的，有男子一百一十名；

text_en: Of the descendants of Adonikam, those who came later, their names being Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah, and with them sixty males.
text_cn: 阿多尼干的子孙，是最后来的，他们的名字是厄里培肋特、耶依耳和舍玛雅，同他们一起的，有男子六十名。

text_en: Of the descendants of Bigvai, Uthai and Zaccur, and with them seventy males.
text_cn: 彼革外的子孙，有匝雇尔的儿子乌泰，同他一起的，有男子七十名。

text_en: I gathered them by the river that runs to Ahava, and there we camped three days. As I reviewed the people and the priests, I found there none of the descendants of Levi.
text_cn: 我将众人召集在流往阿哈瓦的河边， 在那里住了三天；当我视察民众和司祭时，其中没有发现一个肋未人。

text_en: Then I sent for Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam, who were leaders, and for Joiarib and Elnathan, who were wise,
text_cn: 我遂派首领厄里厄则尔、阿黎耳、舍玛雅、厄耳纳堂、雅黎布、厄耳纳堂、纳堂、则加黎雅和默叔蓝，通士约雅黎布和厄耳纳堂，

text_en: and sent them to Iddo, the leader at the place called Casiphia, telling them what to say to Iddo and his colleagues the temple servants at Casiphia, namely, to send us ministers for the house of our God.
text_cn: 命他们到加息非雅地方的首领依多那里去；我并把他们应向那定居在加息非雅的依多和他的弟兄们，要说的话告诉了他们，好为我们天主的殿，给我们带来侍役。

text_en: Since the gracious hand of our God was upon us, they brought us a man of discretion, of the descendants of Mahli son of Levi son of Israel, namely Sherebiah, with his sons and kin, eighteen;
text_cn: 赖我们天主慈悲的手对我们的扶助，他们由以色列的儿子肋未的后裔玛赫里的子孙中，给我们带来了一位明智人，就是舍勒彼雅，和他的儿子及兄弟，一共十八人；

text_en: also Hashabiah and with him Jeshaiah of the descendants of Merari, with his kin and their sons, twenty;
text_cn: 还有哈沙彼雅，同他一起的，有默辣黎的子孙耶沙雅和他的兄弟及儿子，一共二十人；

text_en: besides two hundred twenty of the temple servants, whom David and his officials had set apart to attend the Levites. These were all mentioned by name.
text_cn: 还有达味和诸首长为服事肋未人所立的献身者，二百二十人；这些人全都是登记了的。

text_en: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river Ahava, that we might deny ourselves before our God, to seek from him a safe journey for ourselves, our children, and all our possessions.
text_cn: 我遂在阿哈瓦河那里宣布禁食，在我们的天主前自谦自卑，祈求他使我们和我们的子孙，并我们的一切财物，一路平安；

text_en: For I was ashamed to ask the king for a band of soldiers and cavalry to protect us against the enemy on our way, since we had told the king that the hand of our God is gracious to all who seek him, but his power and his wrath are against all who forsake him.
text_cn: 因为我羞于请求君王派遣部队和骑兵，协助我们防御路上的仇敌，因为我们曾向君王说过：“凡寻求我们天主的人，他的手常加助佑；凡离弃他的人，他便施行强力和义怒。”

text_en: So we fasted and petitioned our God for this, and he listened to our entreaty.
text_cn: 我们为此禁食，祈求我们的天主，他便俯听了我们。

text_en: Then I set apart twelve of the leading priests: Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their kin with them.
text_cn: 我由司祭的首领中选了十二人，又选了舍勒彼雅和哈沙彼雅，以及同他们在一起的十个兄弟，

text_en: And I weighed out to them the silver and the gold and the vessels, the offering for the house of our God that the king, his counselors, his lords, and all Israel there present had offered;
text_cn: 把金银和器皿，即君王和他的参谋、首长，以及在那里所有的以色列人，奉献给我们天主殿宇的礼品，一一衡量了交给他们。

text_en: I weighed out into their hand six hundred fifty talents of silver, and one hundred silver vessels worth . . . talents, and one hundred talents of gold,
text_cn: 我衡量了交在他们手中的，有银子六百五十“塔冷通”，银器一百“塔冷通”，金子一百“塔冷通”；

text_en: twenty gold bowls worth a thousand darics, and two vessels of fine polished bronze as precious as gold.
text_cn: 还有金碗二十个，值一千“达理克”；发亮的铜器两个，贵如黄金。

text_en: And I said to them, “You are holy to the Lord , and the vessels are holy; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering to the Lord , the God of your ancestors.
text_cn: 我向他们说：“你们在上主前是圣的，器皿也是圣的，金银是自愿献于上主你们祖先的天主，作礼品的。

text_en: Guard them and keep them until you weigh them before the chief priests and the Levites and the heads of families in Israel at Jerusalem, within the chambers of the house of the Lord . ”
text_cn: 你们要谨慎护守，直到在耶路撒冷，在上主殿宇的库房内，当着司祭和肋未人的首领，以及以色列众族长的面，衡量交清为止。”

text_en: So the priests and the Levites took over the silver, the gold, and the vessels as they were weighed out, to bring them to Jerusalem, to the house of our God.
text_cn: 司祭和肋未人，就把数点过的金银和器皿收下，带到耶路撒冷我们天主的殿内。

text_en: Then we left the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem; the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy and from ambushes along the way.
text_cn: 一月十二日，我们从阿哈瓦河起程赴耶路撒冷，赖我们天主的手扶助，我们一路脱免了仇人和暗害者的手，

text_en: We came to Jerusalem and remained there three days.
text_cn: 平安到了耶路撒冷，在那里休息了三天。

text_en: On the fourth day, within the house of our God, the silver, the gold, and the vessels were weighed into the hands of the priest Meremoth son of Uriah, and with him was Eleazar son of Phinehas, and with them were the Levites, Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.
text_cn: 第四日，在我们天主的殿内，衡量了金银和器皿，交给了乌利雅的儿子默勒摩特司祭，同他在一起的，还有丕乃哈斯的儿子厄肋阿匝尔，以及肋未人耶叔亚的儿子约匝巴得，和彼奴依的儿子诺阿狄雅，

text_en: The total was counted and weighed, and the weight of everything was recorded.
text_cn: 每件点过称过，即将总数记录下来。

text_en: At that time those who had come from captivity, the returned exiles, offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel, twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, and as a sin offering twelve male goats; all this was a burnt offering to the Lord .
text_cn: 当时被掳充军回来的子民，向以色列的天主奉献了全燔祭，为全以色列献了牛犊十二头，公绵羊九十六只，羔羊七十二只，作赎罪祭的公山羊十二只：这一切都献给上主作全燔祭。

text_en: They also delivered the king’s commissions to the king’s satraps and to the governors of the province Beyond the River; and they supported the people and the house of God.
text_cn: 以后，他们向君王的州长和河西诸省长，呈上君王的谕令；他们便协助民众，资助天主的殿宇。
